overview.text: The Western Massasauga is a small venomous rattlesnake of the south-western plains of the United States and northern Mexico.

size.label: Adults
size.text: Usually 46 to 66 cm, up to 88.3 cm.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: From south-eastern Colorado, Nebraska and Missouri through Kansas and Oklahoma into Texas, and northern Mexico.

habitat.text: Grassland, open woodland edges and rocky hillsides; it often shelters in other animals' burrows.

diet.text: Mainly rodents, plus lizards and frogs.

recognise.text: Small rattlesnake with a rattle and dark blotches.
